27-15 Astoria Boulevard offers modern rental homes in Astoria, Queens, a neighborhood known for its wide variety of restaurants, local cafés, parks, and convenient access to public transportation. Located near Astoria Boulevard, the building provides easy access to everyday shopping, neighborhood amenities, and convenient connections to Manhattan and other parts of New York City.

The apartments are designed for comfortable everyday living, featuring open layouts, large windows that bring in plenty of natural light, modern kitchens with stainless steel appliances, stylish finishes, and well-designed living spaces. Combining a convenient location with thoughtfully designed homes, 27-15 Astoria Boulevard offers a comfortable place to enjoy everything Astoria has to offer. Forten rises above West 126th Street with striking vertical lines and a glass-clad façade, presenting a bold yet refined architectural statement within this fast-evolving Uptown Manhattan district. The ground floor features thoughtfully programmed retail space, including restaurants and a bar, offering everyday convenience in a sophisticated setting. Each home is designed for seamless city living — with panoramic views, floor-to-ceiling windows, and access to an amenity suite rivaling private clubs. This is Uptown Manhattan living, reimagined for the modern era. Just one block from the A/B/C/D subway lines and surrounded by the neighborhood’s most dynamic destinations, Forten sits at the intersection of city energy and campus serenity. From nearby cafés to riverside parks and cultural institutions, everything you need is close — and beautifully connected.
